name: ai-support-ticket-triage
description: Classify support tickets with an LLM (category, urgency, summary, draft reply), show a triage report, and only save the draft replies after a human approves.

tickets_file.description: JSON file with an array of { id, from, subject, body }. Relative paths are resolved from the directory Lobster runs in.

outbox.description: Folder where approved draft replies are written

steps.run: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_TICKETS_FILE.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); const tickets = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path, "utf8")); if (!Array.isArray(tickets) || !tickets.length) throw new Error("No tickets found in " + path); console.log(JSON.stringify(tickets))'

steps.pipeline: llm.invoke --prompt 'You are a support lead. Triage this customer ticket. category: bug, billing, how_to, feature_request or spam. urgency: high if the customer is blocked or charged incorrectly, low for ideas and questions. summary: one short sentence. reply: a friendly, specific reply under 80 words, signed "The Support Team" (empty string for spam).' --output-schema '{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","enum":["bug","billing","how_to","feature_request","spam"]},"urgency":{"type":"string","enum":["high","medium","low"]},"summary":{"type":"string"},"reply":{"type":"string"}},"required":["category","urgency","summary","reply"]}'

steps.run: node -e 'const rows = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).map(r => { const ai = Array.isArray(r.ai) ? r.ai[0] : r.ai; return Object.assign({}, r.ticket, ai.output.data) }); const order = { high: 0, medium: 1, low: 2 }; rows.sort((a, b) => order[a.urgency] - order[b.urgency]); const icon = { high: "🔴", medium: "🟠", low: "🟢" }; const lines = ["Triage report: " + rows.length + " tickets", ""]; rows.forEach(r => lines.push(icon[r.urgency] + " " + r.id + " [" + r.category + "] " + r.subject + " — " + r.summary)); const replies = rows.filter(r => r.category !== "spam" && r.reply).map(r => ({ id: r.id, to: r.from, subject: "Re: " + r.subject, body: r.reply })); lines.push("", replies.length + " draft replies ready (spam is skipped):"); replies.forEach(r => lines.push("", "✉️ To " + r.to + " — " + r.subject, r.body)); console.log(JSON.stringify({ report: lines.join("\n"), reportLines: lines.filter(Boolean), tickets: rows, replies }))'

approval.prompt: Save the draft replies listed in this triage report to the outbox?

steps.run:
node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const dir = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OUTBOX.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); const replies = JSON.parse(process.env.REPLIES); for (const r of replies) { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, r.id + ".md"), "To: " + r.to + "
Subject: " + r.subject + "

" + r.body + "
") } console.log("✅ Saved " + replies.length + " draft replies to " + dir)'
